The '''DPx yacht''' was a 12-meter, "top of the line" [[Yacht/Legends|yacht]] from [[Uulshos Manufacturing/Legends|Uulshos Manufacturing]]. A popular variant of the ship was the long-range [[Scout ship/Legends|scout ship]] called the [[Deep-X Explorer]].

==Characteristics==
The DPx yacht had a dual-[[Engine/Legends|engine]] configuration, making it exceptionally powerful. The large forward-swept-wings made it maneuverable in atmosphere.<ref name="GG8" />

==History==
[[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Kina Ha]] used a DPx for her travels, and later during her hidden watch on her homeworld of [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]].<ref name="GORW">''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]''</ref>
